Requirement Your Rig is active and within 30 feet of you.

You've routed a bleed line from your own nervous system into the Rig's chassis — not enough to matter to it, plenty to matter to you. While your Rig is active and nearby, treat your Drift score as 2 lower than its actual value solely for determining which Drift band's effects apply to you. Your Drift total itself, and anything that keys off the real number, is unaffected.
